Patrick Stewart Impression Voiceover

The original Money Supermarket advert voice... Mr Patrick Stewart.

My Patrick Stewart Sound-a-Like

From *Star Trek* to *X-Men*, I love the gravitas and quirkiness of Sir Patrick Stewart’s voice. This is my homage to the legend.

The original voice of TV’s MoneySuperMarket adverts, you're now watching my faithful recreation of that iconic delivery.

For other projects using my Patrick Stewart-style voice, check out:

  • Hide The Corpse – Dark and dramatic narration
  • Lending Crowd – Calm, confident delivery

Your Kind of Supermarket?

MoneySuperMarket.com Group PLC is a British price comparison website specialising in financial services, from mortgages to credit cards and loans.

It grew to become a household name thanks in part to its memorable TV adverts – and of course, the legendary voice that launched the campaign. Patrick Stewart’s delivery gave those ads their *gravitas with a wink*, and set the tone for years to come.

For a parody, homage, or tongue-in-cheek campaign in that iconic style, I’ve got you covered.

Need a Patrick Stewart Sound-a-Like?

Whether you're creating a spoof, an epic promo, or a narrator with authority and warmth, I’ve voiced scripts in this style for:

  • TV campaigns like CBS & NFL’s King Henry
  • Gaming clients including Minecraft Backpack Promo
  • Corporate promos such as European Collaboration Summit and Lending Crowd
